artifactType: UA26 V3 faithful root-layout Caltrop pairing reproduction and focused test replay

rootCause.priorV2StagingDifference: V2 staging symlinked tests/helpers/ua-source-batch6-jo-fixture.mjs. Node resolved that module to the production checkout, while the copied test passed it a temporary-root absolute path. readBeforeJoFile therefore derived a relative path outside its scoped-history list and returned raw live bytes, so staged V2 bypassed the production-root projection and passed 17/17.
rootCause.explanation: In this root-layout replay, tests/helpers/ua-source-batch6-jo-fixture.mjs is copied into the staged root, so readBeforeJoFile and the copied test share a root. The scoped Caltrop read projects to the pinned pre-Jo checkpoint. The installed V2 assertion compared that projected value to the live after hash. V3 verifies the projection against the before hash and separately reads the live filesystem bytes for the after hash.
